description: Climatescope - Mapping the Global Frontiers for Clean Energy Investment is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Climate, Renewable energy", published or maintained by BNEF (Bloomberg New Energy Finance). Climatescope 2017 tracks the conditions for clean energy investment on and off the grid, and provides a wealth of publicly-available information on 71 emerging markets in Africa, Asia and Latin America & the Caribbean. To learn more, please visit Citation: developed by Bloomberg New Energy Finance with the support of UKaid and USAID. Coverage: Sub-Saharan Africa, East Asia and the Pacific, Europe and Central Asia, Latin America and the Caribbean, the Middle East and North Africa, South Asia. It has 9 files in PDF, XLS, CSV. The portal files it under Climate, Renewable energy. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
